name: Tharnariun Treetender
summary: In Auberdine, Tharnariun Treetender watches for sickness in Darkshore’s wilds. The night elf naturalist studies the corruption spreading through plants and animals, seeking ways to protect them.

sections.title: A Guardian in Auberdine
sections.body: Tharnariun Treetender watches the woods beyond Auberdine’s port. Satyrs and foul shoreline washaways threaten the village, yet his work is with the natural world around it. He believes neglecting nature invites ruin. So he studies the decline of the local woods and seeks ways to fight the sickness spreading across the forest floor.

sections.title: Healing the Afflicted
sections.body: Plagues and corrupted blights have driven Darkshore’s creatures mad. Peaceful animals have become rabid threats. Tharnariun seeks a remedy instead of killing them out of fear. He uses cleansers and targets the worst of the contagion, hoping to save what remains of the wilderness from decay.

faq.answer: Tharnariun is a night elf caretaker in Auberdine, on Darkshore’s coast. He watches the forest and studies the unnatural afflictions troubling its wildlife.

faq.q: Where can I find Tharnariun Treetender?
faq.answer: You can find Tharnariun in Auberdine, the night elf village on Darkshore’s western edge.

faq.q: What problems is Tharnariun investigating in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Tharnariun investigates the corruption and plagues spreading through Darkshore’s land and wildlife. He sends adventurers to cleanse infected beasts and stop the blight.

faq.q: Why does Tharnariun care so much about diseased animals?
faq.answer: Tharnariun believes neglecting nature brings consequences for the night elves. He works to cleanse sick creatures rather than abandon the forest to corruption.

faq.q: What quests does Tharnariun Treetender offer?
faq.answer: Tharnariun directs adventurers to address blighted land and wildlife through 'Plagued Lands', 'Cleansing of the Infected', and 'Tharnariun's Hope'.
Tharnariun is not called a druid outright. His concern for preserving beasts and plants echoes the Cenarion Circle, and he cares for Darkshore’s wilderness.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, you may feel the weight of Tharnariun’s warnings. Your people have an ancient duty to watch over the natural balance of northern Kalimdor.
As a druid, you share Tharnariun’s concern for blighted wildlife and the work of restoring harmony to corrupted lands.
Auberdine is the Alliance’s main coastal gateway in northern Kalimdor. Tharnariun’s defense of the surrounding woods helps protect the outpost.
